newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Indian foreign minister puts off Sri Lanka visit.
newsitem.headline: Indian foreign minister puts off Sri Lanka visit.

text.p: Indian External Affairs Minister Inder Kumar Gujral has postponed a visit to Sri Lanka scheduled for this week because of ill health, the Foreign Ministry said on Monday.
Gujral was to have visited Colombo on October 24-27 to co-chair the third meeting of the Indo-Sri Lanka Joint Commission with his Sri Lankan counterpart Lakshman Kadirgamar.
His visit will be rescheduled at the earliest opportunity, a ministry statement said.
The joint commission is held regularly by the two neighbours to promote economic, technical and cultural cooperation.
